LandingPage.subHeroText: Access limitless cloud storage directly through Telegram's MTProto API. Upload, manage, and share your files instantly with zero middleman databases, no file sizes caps, and complete ownership of your data.

driveWidget.title: My Telegramonic Drive
driveWidget.dropzoneTitle: Drag and drop files to upload
driveWidget.dropzoneSubtitle: Syncs immediately directly with Telegram API

features.title: Engineered for Performance
features.subtitle: Everything you need to manage your digital life with minimal friction.

infinite.title: Infinite Storage
infinite.description: Break free from restrictive quotas. Leverage Telegram's limitless infrastructure to store documents, media, and archives without ever worrying about running out of space.

security.title: Bank-Grade Security
security.description: Your files are protected by MTProto 2.0 encryption — the same protocol securing 900M+ Telegram users. Only you hold the decryption keys.

transfers.title: Turbocharged Transfers
transfers.description: Experience unmatched upload and download speeds optimized across global distributed servers.

sync.title: Seamless Sync across Devices
sync.description: Access your files instantly from your desktop, tablet, or phone. Changes sync in real-time across the ecosystem.

search.title: Instant Smart Search
search.description: Find any file in milliseconds with full-text search across filenames, types, and metadata. No more endless scrolling.

share.title: One-Click Sharing
share.description: Generate secure shareable links instantly. Set expiry times, password-protect links, and revoke access at any time.

Footer.tagline: Unlimited cloud storage, secure, fast, and completely powered by Telegram.

LoginPage.title: Connect Telegram Drive
LoginPage.subtitle: Access your unlimited cloud storage space via MTProto 2.0 secure API connection.

phone.title: Phone Number

phone.label: Phone Number

phone.errorEmpty: Phone number is required to proceed.

code.title: Enter Verification Code
code.description: We sent a verification code to your Telegram app or via SMS. Please enter it below.
code.label: Verification Code

api.title: API Configuration
api.description: Provide your custom Telegram API credentials. Obtain these securely from my.telegram.org.

ProductPage.heroSubtitle: Run Telegramonic on all your devices. Enjoy high-speed cloud storage powered securely by the MTProto network.
